newsitem.title: USA: Vermont Yankee nuclear plant begins startup -- NRC.
newsitem.headline: Vermont Yankee nuclear plant begins startup -- NRC.

text.p: The 510 megawatt Vermont Yankee nuclear power plant began restart late Wednesday after a week long postponement of its return from a refueling outage, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said Thursday.
The Vernon, Vt., generating station was running at one percent of capacity and increasing power, NRC said in today's daily status report.
The delay of Vermont Yankee's startup stemmed from longer-than-expected amount of time NRC needed to review the plant's fire protection system.

Vermont Yankee is owned by a consortium of New England utilities including Central Vermont Public Service Co (31.3 percent), New England Electric System (20), Green Mountain Power (17.9), Northeast Utilities (16) and Central Maine Power Co (4.0).
